name: loan.application.user.read
note: Users see every application, approved ones included.

name: loan.application.user.edit
note: Users create and change applications until they are approved. From then on only admins can change them, and users can never delete one.

name: loan.application.admin
note: Admins have full access, approved applications included.

name: loan.application.tag.user
note: Users pick tags on a loan, only admins manage the list.

name: loan.application.document.type.user
note: Users see which documents a loan needs, only admins decide that.

name: loan.application.document.type.admin
note: Admins decide which documents a loan needs.

name: loan.application.document.user
note: Users fill in the compliance checklist of their loans.

name: loan.application.document.admin
note: Admins have full access to every checklist.
